previous.changeLog: In-battle MoE projection should now be closer at every mark threshold.

current.changeLog:
Alongside the corner overlay, the mod can now draw a wide progress bar in the centre of the screen during battle. It's off by default — turn it on in the settings panel under Progress Bar, then pick which of the two bars you want.
Moving Average — where your career projected average combined damage sits between the mark you already hold and the requirement for the next one, with this battle's signed contribution beside it. It comes up whenever that projection moves.
Damage Efficiency — this battle's combined damage measured against all requirements at once laid out on equal quarters, with every requirement you've already passed lit up.
Elite Rewards tooltips now tell you which level a reward unlocks at.

previous.changeLog: Quietly ignores harmless stale hangar GameObject is invalid refresh failures and empty or malformed customization descriptors, reducing noisy mod exception reports without changing Camo Selector behavior.

current.changeLog: Fixed an issue where deleted custom assets could leave behind an empty “Custom assets” entry. Missing custom assets are now hidden, blocked from applying, and cleaned from saved outfits. Custom assets should now appear more reliably in the carousel. A cache-related stale entry may still remain for some users.

previous.changeLog:
